question:
Which of the following pair of sports persons - sports associated with is correct?

I. Pooja Vastrakar - Shooting

II. Kuldeep Yadav - Cricket
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kuldeep Yadav** is an Indian cricketer who plays for the national team.
 
• He is known for his role as a **left-arm wrist spin bowler**.
 
• Kuldeep Yadav has represented India in various formats of the game including Test matches, One Day Internationals (ODIs), and Twenty20 Internationals (T20Is).
 
• **Pooja Vastrakar** is not associated with shooting; she is an Indian cricketer known for her all-round performances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuldeep Yadav**

 
 
• Kuldeep Yadav made his debut for the Indian cricket team in March 2017 in a Test match against Australia.
 
• He has taken numerous wickets and has been a key player in several matches for India.
 
• Yadav is also known for his hat-tricks in ODIs, a rare feat in cricket.
 
• He has played for the Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) in the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
 
 
• **Pooja Vastrakar**
 
 
• Pooja Vastrakar is an Indian cricketer who plays as an all-rounder for the national team.
 
• She made her debut in international cricket in February 2018.
 
• Vastrakar is known for her right-arm medium-fast bowling and her capability as a lower-order batsman.
 
• She has represented India in both ODIs and T20Is.
